meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 为 NanoClaw 在 macOS 菜单栏添加状态图标:闪电图标配绿/红点显示运行状态,并提供开始、停止、重启控制。仅支持 macOS,需安装 Xcode 命令行工具。
howto.when: 当用户要求为 NanoClaw 添加 macOS 菜单栏状态指示器时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加菜单栏状态指示器
say.note: 开始编译并安装到菜单栏。

say.text: 检查 NanoClaw 的菜单栏状态指示器装了吗
say.note: 验证是否已运行,已装则跳过安装。

say.text: 卸载 NanoClaw 菜单栏状态指示器

howto.what_en: Adds a menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw on macOS: a bolt icon with a green/red dot showing running status, plus Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only; requires Xcode Command Line Tools.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add a menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Compiles and installs it to the menu bar.

say_en.text: Check if NanoClaw's menu bar status indicator is installed.
say_en.note: Verifies whether it's already running; skips install if so.

say_en.text: Uninstall NanoClaw's menu bar status indicator.
